engineering_consequences: Treat 0.2 m3/min as listed inlet air consumption with unspecified reference basis, not cold delivery.
Do not assign EXAIR 162 W or its backpressure allowance to the Amazon unit.
A control-setting sweep may increase useful flow at a warmer cold temperature. Measure rather than optimize for the minimum temperature alone.
Keep pressure, source inlet temperature and downstream attachment effects in the test record.
Source maps and reference tables cannot replace geometry and measured downstream boundary conditions for validated CFD.
